name: Umbral Flight
descriptionTemplate: Deal [Damage:Arg1] DMG [Arg2] {plural:[Arg2]|time|times}, increase other allies' Temporary Crit. DMG by [Arg3]%. {Quasar}: Shuffle 1 {Onyx Plume} into the Draw Pile and gain [Block:Arg4] Shield.
lore:
He is not one to endlessly endure without fighting back; those wings can also stir up a furious vortex.
All flesh will be torn apart by the wind's sharp teeth, bloodily dragged into the belly of death.
But there is no need to fear; he will place your name in the eye of the hurricane, in the tranquility at its very center.
